            <h1>Keylime</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Keylime</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
        </section>
    </div>
    

    
    
    

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');

            <h1>Kiali Operator</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Kiali Operator</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (1)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Kiali Operator supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

    if (designLinks.length === 0) {

    const relatedTutorials = document.querySelectorAll(".tutorial-link");

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
            <h1>Knative Serving</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Knative Serving</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (11)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Knative Serving supports the following components.</p>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    function handleImageError(image) {
        image.onerror = null;
        image.src = '\/extensions\/models\/knative-serving\/icons\/color\/knative-serving-color.svg';
    }
    const designLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.design-link');
    if (designLinks.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('related-designs-header').style.display = 'none';
    }

    const relatedTutorials = document.querySelectorAll(".tutorial-link");
    if (relatedTutorials.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById("related-tutorials-header").style.display = "none";
    }

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    function handleImageError(image) {
        image.onerror = null;
        image.src = '\/extensions\/models\/kommander\/icons\/color\/kommander-color.svg';
    }
    const designLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.design-link');
    if (designLinks.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('related-designs-header').style.display = 'none';
    }

    const relatedTutorials = document.querySelectorAll(".tutorial-link");
    if (relatedTutorials.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById("related-tutorials-header").style.display = "none";
    }

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    function handleImageError(image) {
        image.onerror = null;
        image.src = '\/extensions\/models\/kong-mesh\/icons\/color\/kong-mesh-color.svg';
    }
    const designLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.design-link');
    if (designLinks.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('related-designs-header').style.display = 'none';
    }

    const relatedTutorials = document.querySelectorAll(".tutorial-link");
    if (relatedTutorials.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById("related-tutorials-header").style.display = "none";
    }

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>ArangoDB Kubernetes Operator</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for ArangoDB Kubernetes Operator</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (22)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for ArangoDB Kubernetes Operator supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
            
            <div class="maincontainer">
                <div class="componentimg">
                    <img class="logo-dark-light"

                </div>
                <p class="Compitems">graph-analytics-engine</p>
            </div>
            
            
            
            <div class="maincontainer">
                <div class="componentimg">
                    <img class="logo-dark-light"
                        src="/content/en/extensions/models/kube-arangodb/components/arango-job/icons/color/arango-job-color.svg"
                        alt="arango-job"
                        onerror="handleImageError(this)"
                        data-logo-for-dark="/content/en/extensions/models/kube-arangodb/components/arango-job/icons/white/arango-job-white.svg"
                        data-logo-for-light="/content/en/extensions/models/kube-arangodb/components/arango-job/icons/color/arango-job-color.svg" />
                </div>
                <p class="Compitems">arango-job</p>
            </div>
            
            
            
            <div class="maincontainer">
                <div class="componentimg">
                    <img class="logo-dark-light"
                        src="/content/en/extensions/models/kube-arangodb/components/arango-backup/icons/color/arango-backup-color.svg"
                        alt="arango-backup"

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>Kube Prometheus</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Kube Prometheus</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (10)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Kube Prometheus supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
            
            <div class="maincontainer">
                <div class="componentimg">
                    <img class="logo-dark-light"
                        src="/content/en/extensions/models/kube-prometheus/components/alertmanager-config/icons/color/alertmanager-config-color.svg"
                        alt="alertmanager-config"
                        onerror="handleImageError(this)"
                        data-logo-for-dark="/content/en/extensions/models/kube-prometheus/components/alertmanager-config/icons/white/alertmanager-config-white.svg"
                        data-logo-for-light="/content/en/extensions/models/kube-prometheus/components/alertmanager-config/icons/color/alertmanager-config-color.svg" />
                </div>
                <p class="Compitems">alertmanager-config</p>
            </div>
            
            
            
            <div class="maincontainer">
                <div class="componentimg">
                    <img class="logo-dark-light"

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>kube-rs</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for kube-rs</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (1)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for kube-rs supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
            
            <div class="maincontainer">
                <div class="componentimg">
                    <img class="logo-dark-light"
                        src="/content/en/extensions/models/kube-rs/components/document/icons/color/document-color.svg"
                        alt="document"
                        onerror="handleImageError(this)"
                        data-logo-for-dark="/content/en/extensions/models/kube-rs/components/document/icons/white/document-white.svg"
                        data-logo-for-light="/content/en/extensions/models/kube-rs/components/document/icons/color/document-color.svg" />
                </div>
                <p class="Compitems">document</p>
            </div>
            
            
        </section>
    </div>
    

    
    
    

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

    function handleImageError(image) {
        image.onerror = null;
        image.src = '\/extensions\/models\/kube-ui-server\/icons\/color\/kube-ui-server-color.svg';
    }
    const designLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.design-link');
    if (designLinks.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('related-designs-header').style.display = 'none';
    }

    const relatedTutorials = document.querySelectorAll(".tutorial-link");
    if (relatedTutorials.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById("related-tutorials-header").style.display = "none";
    }

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>Kubedb CRDs</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Kubedb CRDs</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (133)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Kubedb CRDs supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
            
            <div class="maincontainer">
                <div class="componentimg">

                </div>
                <p class="Compitems">hazelcast-version</p>
            </div>
            
            
            
            <div class="maincontainer">
                <div class="componentimg">
                    <img class="logo-dark-light"
                        src="/content/en/extensions/models/kubedb-crds/components/oracle-version/icons/color/oracle-version-color.svg"
                        alt="oracle-version"
                        onerror="handleImageError(this)"
                        data-logo-for-dark="/content/en/extensions/models/kubedb-crds/components/oracle-version/icons/white/oracle-version-white.svg"
                        data-logo-for-light="/content/en/extensions/models/kubedb-crds/components/oracle-version/icons/color/oracle-version-color.svg" />
                </div>
                <p class="Compitems">oracle-version</p>
            </div>
            
            
            
            <div class="maincontainer">
                <div class="componentimg">
                    <img class="logo-dark-light"
                        src="/content/en/extensions/models/kubedb-crds/components/hazelcast/icons/color/hazelcast-color.svg"
                        alt="hazelcast"

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

            <h1>Kubedb Grafana Dashboards</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Kubedb Grafana Dashboards</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (1)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Kubedb Grafana Dashboards supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
            <h1>Kubedb Metrics</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Kubedb Metrics</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (1)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Kubedb Metrics supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
            
            <div class="maincontainer">
                <div class="componentimg">
                    <img class="logo-dark-light"
                        src="/content/en/extensions/models/kubedb-metrics/components/metrics-configuration/icons/color/metrics-configuration-color.svg"
                        alt="metrics-configuration"
                        onerror="handleImageError(this)"
                        data-logo-for-dark="/content/en/extensions/models/kubedb-metrics/components/metrics-configuration/icons/white/metrics-configuration-white.svg"
                        data-logo-for-light="/content/en/extensions/models/kubedb-metrics/components/metrics-configuration/icons/color/metrics-configuration-color.svg" />
                </div>
                <p class="Compitems">metrics-configuration</p>
            </div>
            
            
        </section>
    </div>
    

    
    
    

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

    function handleImageError(image) {
        image.onerror = null;
        image.src = '\/extensions\/models\/kubedb-metrics\/icons\/color\/kubedb-metrics-color.svg';
    }
    const designLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.design-link');
    if (designLinks.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('related-designs-header').style.display = 'none';
    }

    const relatedTutorials = document.querySelectorAll(".tutorial-link");
    if (relatedTutorials.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById("related-tutorials-header").style.display = "none";
    }

    $(document).ready(function () {

        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)

            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);

            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {

                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });

            <h1>Kubedb Ops Manager</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Kubedb Ops Manager</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (1)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Kubedb Ops Manager supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
            
            <div class="maincontainer">

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>
